title: fix: report code agent failures with their real status and message
author: voodoohop
pr_body_excerpt:
- Fix: errors thrown outside `respond()` in a code agent isolate (e.g. an MCP `tools/list` failure, or a direct `generateText` call hitting 402) collapsed into a generic 500 "Code agent execution failed".
- Reuses the shared `agentResponsesError` mapping already bundled in the runtime: model errors keep their upstream status, everything else returns 502 with the message, the same as prompt agents.
- Updates the MCP failure tests to assert the real messages and adds a 402 pass-through test.
- Existing code agents pick this up on their next sync (the runtime bundle is pinned at deploy time).

gist.headline: The agent says what happened
gist.blurb: Code agents have stopped filing every mishap under the same mysterious 500. MCP and model errors now carry their actual status and message back through the hive.
gist.summary: Code-agent runtime errors thrown outside respond(), including MCP tools/list failures and generateText 402 responses, now use the shared agentResponsesError mapping to preserve upstream model statuses and return other error messages as 502s.
gist.impact: Developers now receive actionable MCP failure messages and pass-through 402 model responses instead of a generic "Code agent execution failed" 500, once their code agents next sync the deployed runtime.
